security_audit.summary: The subprocess and shell detections are legitimate GitHub and Git automation using argv lists, quoted parameters, or documentation examples. No prompt injection, hidden exfiltration, obfuscation, or unauthorized security bypass intent was found in the cited files.

remediation.issue: Helper scripts can change GitHub PR labels, reviewers, and project boards.
remediation.suggestion: Add an explicit dry-run mode and require confirmation before mutating PR or project state.

remediation.issue: The documentation includes a shell command substitution example for PR body creation.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer a temporary body file example to reduce copy and paste risk in user shells.

remediation.issue: Automated commands depend on an authenticated GitHub CLI session.
remediation.suggestion: Document required permissions and advise users to review the target repository before running scripts.

content.user_title: Review Pull Requests with Quality Gates
content.value_statement: Pull request reviews can miss risks, unclear scope, and merge blockers. This skill structures PR review, creation, quality checks, and merge decisions.
actual_capabilities: Drafts pull request titles and descriptions from branch changes.
Reviews PRs with checklists for correctness, security, testing, performance, and documentation.
Runs GitHub CLI based quality gates for CI status, tests, security patterns, and PR size.
Suggests merge strategies based on commit history and review readiness.
Can apply labels, assign reviewers, and sync PRs to project boards through helper scripts.
limitations: Requires GitHub CLI access for automated PR operations.
Does not replace human approval for sensitive or high risk code changes.
Quality gate results depend on repository CI, test, and coverage configuration.
Project board syncing depends on available GitHub project permissions.

use_cases.title: Review an Open PR
use_cases.description: Run a structured review that checks CI, tests, security concerns, and merge readiness.

use_cases.title: Prepare a PR for Review
use_cases.description: Create a clear PR title, description, testing notes, and related issue links.

use_cases.title: Standardize Team PR Gates
use_cases.description: Apply repeatable checks for size, coverage, security, and review approval before merge.

prompt_templates.title: Review a PR
prompt_templates.prompt: Review PR #123. Summarize the main changes, quality gate status, risks, and merge recommendation.

prompt_templates.title: Create a PR Description
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a PR title and description for my current branch. Include summary, changes, testing, and related issues.

prompt_templates.title: Check Merge Readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Check whether PR #123 is ready to merge. Review CI, tests, approvals, comments, size, and merge strategy.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Deep Review Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Review PR #123 using quality gates, security checks, commit quality, issue links, reviewer status, and project workflow impact.

output: PR summary with scope, files changed, and main behavior changes.
Quality gate results for CI, tests, security checks, size, and approvals.
Clear decision such as approve, comment, or request changes, with reasons.

output_examples.input: Create a PR for my current branch.
output: Suggested title using the repository style.
Structured description with summary, changes, testing, and issue links.
Pre-review checklist that calls out missing tests or documentation.

output_examples.input: Should I squash or merge this PR?
output: Commit history assessment and recommended merge method.
Reasoning based on commit quality, PR size, and desired history.
Warnings for unresolved comments, failing checks, or risky changes.

best_practices: Use this skill with a checked out repository and authenticated GitHub CLI session.
Ask for a review summary before posting comments or changing PR state.
Treat quality gate failures as review blockers unless the team has approved an exception.
anti_patterns: Do not auto-approve sensitive changes without human review.
Do not merge when CI, tests, or required approvals are missing.
Do not use project syncing scripts without confirming repository and project permissions.

faq.question: Does this skill create pull requests automatically?
faq.answer: It can guide PR creation and includes helper scripts. GitHub CLI access is required for automated creation.

faq.question: Can it post reviews on GitHub?
faq.answer: The skill helps draft reviews and decisions. Posting depends on the available tools and user approval.

faq.question: Does it run tests for my project?
faq.answer: It checks CI status and PR signals. Project test execution depends on repository commands and CI configuration.

faq.question: Can it detect security issues in a PR?
faq.answer: It includes checklist guidance and simple diff scanning. It is not a full application security scanner.

faq.question: Which merge strategy does it recommend?
faq.answer: It compares merge commit, squash, and rebase based on commit quality and team workflow.

faq.question: Does it require GitHub?
faq.answer: The helper scripts are designed for GitHub and the GitHub CLI. General review guidance can still apply elsewhere.
